architecture.mechanism: Fire compartmentalization physically contains thermal runaway within the battery enclosure, blocking heat/flame transfer to surrounding flammable materials and preventing fire spread beyond the pack.
architecture.intervention: Add fire-rated compartment barriers (intumescent partitions and thermal isolation) around the R519 battery pack and remove/separate flammable materials from the battery bay so a runaway cell is confined locally while shutdown and egress paths remain functional.
architecture.expected_effect: Thermal runaway stays contained inside the battery compartment, preventing progression to vehicle fire and preserving occupant egress and vehicle shutdown.
architecture.falsification_test: Initiate thermal runaway in one cell of an instrumented full battery pack and confirm by thermocouple array and high-speed video that no flame, sustained ignition, or hazardous heat flux crosses the compartment barrier during the shutdown/egress window.
